title: Duck Bridge Builders
shortDescription: Build a bridge. Guide the ducklings. Brace for the hippo.
description: Carry timber as a beaver builder and construct a bridge across five cozy 3D landscapes. Test your design with ten ducklings, then see whether it can support a very heavy hippo inspector. Watch the physics, repair the damage, and try again.
controls: Desktop keyboard and mouse: use WASD to move the beaver and the pointer to aim building pieces. Follow the on-screen guide for picking up, rotating, placing, and reinforcing timber.
Use Test Bridge to start an inspection, then repair or restart after the results. Touch controls are not available in this version.
saveNote: Level results and settings are stored locally in this browser. Existing saved progress stays on the same game origin. Hidden tabs pause play.
coverAlt: Duck Bridge Builders showing a beaver beside a river and timber supplies in a colorful 3D landscape
